info.title: Bindery
info.description:
Bindery REST API — automated book (ebook/audiobook) library manager, the modern replacement for Readarr.

This specification is reverse-engineered from the Bindery sources (github.com/vavallee/bindery, commit e11987b, v1.31.0); upstream ships no machine-readable spec. Handlers are the authority for every shape here.

## Authentication

Requests authenticate with an API key (`X-Api-Key` header, or `?apikey=` on safe methods) or a signed session cookie. Cookie sessions additionally require the CSRF token cookie (`bindery_csrf`) to be echoed back and the header `X-Requested-With: bindery-ui`; API-key requests are exempt from both guards. OPDS endpoints use HTTP Basic instead.

apiKey.name: X-Api-Key
apiKey.description: API key issued in Bindery's settings. May also be passed as the `apikey` query parameter on GET/HEAD/OPTIONS.

sessionCookie.name: bindery_session
sessionCookie.description: Signed session cookie minted by POST /api/v1/auth/login. Requires the CSRF token and `X-Requested-With: bindery-ui` on state-changing requests.

opdsBasicAuth.description: HTTP Basic credentials (a Bindery username + password) validated by `api.OPDSAuth` against the user repo, with a constant-work dummy hash for unknown usernames so timing does not reveal which usernames exist. Realm is `Bindery OPDS`. This is what reading apps (KOReader, Moon+ Reader, Aldiko) use; a successful Basic login attaches the user id to the request context so feeds are scoped to that user's library.

opdsApiKeyHeader.name: X-Api-Key
opdsApiKeyHeader.description: Instance API key, compared in constant time and checked before the local-only network bypass. An API-key caller is unscoped and sees the whole library.

opdsApiKeyQuery.name: apikey
opdsApiKeyQuery.description: Same instance API key supplied as a query parameter, for clients that cannot set headers.

opdsSessionCookie.name: bindery_session
opdsSessionCookie.description: Signed browser session cookie (`auth.SessionCookieName`); its embedded session epoch must still match the user's current `users.session_epoch`.

ABSConfigRequest.description:
Partial update of the ABS configuration. Every field is optional; omitted fields keep their stored value.

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

baseUrl.description: Audiobookshelf base URL; trimmed and normalized before storage.

label.description: Display label; an empty value is stored as "Audiobookshelf".

libraryIds.description: Target book library ids. When present it wins: it is trimmed/de-duplicated and its first entry overwrites libraryId (an empty list clears libraryId).

apiKey.description: Audiobookshelf API key. Validated when non-empty; only written when present and non-empty, so an empty string leaves the stored key intact.

ABSConfigResponse.description: Stored Audiobookshelf source configuration. The API key itself is never returned.

featureEnabled.description: Whether the ABS import feature is enabled on this server build/deployment.

label.description: Display label for the source; defaults to "Audiobookshelf".

enabled.description: Whether this source may be imported from.

libraryId.description: Primary target library id — always the first entry of libraryIds.

libraryIds.description: Selected book library ids, de-duplicated and in saved order.

pathRemap.description: Path remap rule applied to ABS-reported file paths so they resolve under Bindery-visible storage.

apiKeyConfigured.description: True when a write-only API key is stored.

ABSConflict.description: A field where Audiobookshelf and upstream metadata disagree, decorated for display.

entityName.description: Author name or book title; falls back to itemId when the entity is gone.

upstreamValue.description: Value reported by the metadata provider.

appliedSource.description: Which source's value is currently applied; empty while unresolved.

appliedValue.description: The value corresponding to appliedSource; empty while unresolved.

authorRelinkEligible.description: Author conflicts only: true when the placeholder author can be confidently relinked upstream.

ABSImportCheckpoint.description: Resume point for paged library enumeration.

ABSImportItemResult.description: Per-item outcome recorded during an import.

outcome.description: What the importer did with the item.

matchedBy.description: Which resolution rule matched (provenance, foreign id, normalized title, …).

ABSImportProgress.description: In-memory snapshot of the importer's current or last run.

runId.description: Active/last run id; omitted when zero.

ABSImportSourceSnapshot.description: The source configuration captured at the moment a run started.

ABSImportStats.description: Aggregate counters for an import run.

itemsDetailFetched.description: Items for which a detail payload had to be fetched because list data was incomplete.

ownedMarked.description: Books marked owned because their ABS files resolved under Bindery-visible storage.

reviewQueued.description: Ambiguous items parked in the review queue.

ABSImportSummary.description: Persisted summary of a finished run.

ABSLibrary.description: An Audiobookshelf book library visible to the API key.

mediaType.description: Always `book` — other media types are filtered out.

provider.description: ABS metadata provider for the library.

ABSLibraryFolder.description: A filesystem folder backing an Audiobookshelf library.

fullPath.description: Absolute path as reported by ABS.

ABSPersistedImportRun.description: A stored import run, hydrated from its source-config, checkpoint and summary JSON columns. One row per selected library.

ABSProbeRequest.description: Optional per-request credential override for a live probe. `baseUrl` is decoded but ignored — probes always use the saved base URL.

baseUrl.description: Decoded but unused; the saved base URL is always used.

apiKey.description: API key to probe with. When empty or omitted, the stored key is used.

ABSReviewItem.description: An ambiguously matched Audiobookshelf item parked for manual review.

payloadJson.description: The serialized normalized ABS item, replayed on approval.

editedTitle.description: Operator-edited title; replaces the payload title on approval.

fileMappingFound.description: Whether the item's ABS paths currently resolve under Bindery-visible storage. Re-evaluated on each list call.

latestRunId.description: Import run that most recently queued this item.

ABSRollbackAction.description: One planned or applied rollback step.

outcome.description: The outcome the original import recorded for this entity.

action.description: What rollback does/did, e.g. delete, unlink, skip.

reason.description: Why the action was skipped or failed.

ABSRollbackResult.description: Outcome of a rollback preview or execution.

preview.description: True when nothing was applied (preview endpoint).

dryRun.description: True when the run being rolled back was itself a dry run.

foreignBookId.description: Provider id of the work to add. Required.

foreignAuthorId.description: Provider id of the owning author. Optional — when empty the handler resolves it from the book, then by `authorName`.

authorName.description: Fallback author name used to resolve or create the author when no author id is supplied or the provider returns none.

searchOnAdd.description: Dispatch an indexer search-and-grab for the book once it exists.

mediaType.description: Force the added book's media type. Empty keeps the provider's value, falling back to the `default.media_type` setting.

bookId.description: Id of an existing, non-excluded book. Must be positive.

primarySeries.description: Whether this becomes the book's primary series. Defaults to true when omitted.

ApplyReorganizeRequest.description: Body of applyReorganize. Only file ids are accepted — every destination is recomputed server-side, so a client cannot choose where a file lands.

fileIds.description: Tracked file ids to reorganize. Must be non-empty; an empty or absent array is a 400.

updated.description: Number of book rows written. Lower than the series size when persistence aborted part-way.

ArrQueueRecord.description: One queue row in the Radarr/Sonarr-compatible projection served by GET /api/queue.

bookId.description: Linked book id, or 0 when the download has no book (unlike /api/v1/queue, which sends null).

trackedDownloadStatus.description: Synthesised health of the row: `error` when it carries an error message, reports a live error status, or is failed/importFailed/importBlocked; `warning` when its download client poll failed or timed out; otherwise `ok`.

size.description: Bytes. Prefers the live client-reported size, falling back to the stored size.

sizeleft.description: Bytes remaining. Prefers the live remaining size, then a percentage-derived remainder, and reports 0 for completed/terminal states.

downloadClient.description: Download client display name; empty when the client could not be resolved.

downloadId.description: Remote client id — lowercased torrent hash or SABnzbd nzo id; empty when neither is known.

ArrQueueResponse.description: Radarr/Sonarr-shaped paged queue envelope. `page`/`pageSize` are present only when a positive `pageSize` was supplied; `sortKey`/`sortDirection` only when a `sortKey` was supplied.

totalRecords.description: Total matching records before pagination (already excludes `imported` rows).

apiKey.description: The instance API key, usable as the `X-Api-Key` header or the `?apikey=` query parameter (query form honoured on safe methods only). Populated **only** for admin callers; empty string otherwise.

username.description: Caller's username, or the single existing user's username under the local/disabled bypass.

AuthMode.description: Instance auth mode. `enabled`: everyone authenticates. `local-only`: RFC1918/loopback peers bypass auth and are treated as admin. `disabled`: no auth check at all. `proxy`: identity trusted from the configured upstream header when the peer is in a trusted-proxy CIDR.

mode.description: Unrecognised values are silently coerced to `enabled`.

AuthModeRequest.description: Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

authenticated.description: True when a user id was resolved from the session cookie or proxy header, or when the request has admin semantics via the `disabled` / `local-only` bypass.

setupRequired.description: True when the users table is empty and POST /api/v1/auth/setup must be run.

username.description: Omitted when the caller is not a resolved user (e.g. the trusted-local bypass).

localAuthEnabled.description: Mirrors BINDERY_LOCAL_AUTH_ENABLED. When false, password login and local account creation are refused.

Author.description: An author in the library. The core resource: books hang off it, and its monitoring policy, quality/metadata profiles and root folders drive what Bindery searches for and where it files results.

foreignAuthorId.description: Upstream provider identity. The prefix selects the provider: `gb:` Google Books, `hc:` Hardcover, `dnb:` DNB, `calibre:` Calibre, `abs:` Audiobookshelf; an unprefixed id is OpenLibrary.

description.description: Provider biography, passed through the markup/HTML cleaner before it is returned.

imageUrl.description: Portrait URL, rewritten to Bindery's local image proxy on the way out.

disambiguation.description: Provider disambiguation hint used to tell same-named authors apart.

monitored.description: Whether Bindery tracks this author at all. An unmonitored author accepts no newly-discovered books.

monitorMode.description: Which of the author's works are monitored: `all`, `future` (unreleased only), `latest` (the newest `monitorLatestCount`), `none`, or `series` (only books in the pinned `monitoredSeriesIds`).

monitorLatestCount.description: How many of the most recent works to monitor when `monitorMode` is `latest`. Must be positive.

monitorNewItems.description: Policy for works discovered AFTER the initial catalogue sync (refresh paths, not the add flow). `all` follows `monitorMode`; `none` creates newly-discovered works unmonitored so a refresh cannot mass-monitor a back catalogue and trigger a search storm. Importers create authors with `none`.

qualityProfileId.description: Quality profile applied to this author's downloads. Null falls back to the global default.

metadataProfileId.description: Metadata profile whose filters (allowed languages, min pages/popularity, skip part-books, …) gate which provider works become books. Defaults to the seeded Standard profile on create.

rootFolderId.description: Ebook root folder for this author. Null uses the global library dir.

audiobookRootFolderId.description: Audiobook destination override, deliberately separate from `rootFolderId` so an ebook root never redirects audiobooks. Null falls back to the global audiobook library dir.

metadataProvider.description: Provider that owns this author's metadata.

lastMetadataRefreshAt.description: When the author's profile was last refreshed from the provider.

books.description: Joined data — attached by the author detail endpoint only (owner-scoped), omitted elsewhere.

statistics.description: Joined book counts. Omitted when not computed.

aliases.description: Joined data — alternate names, attached by the author detail endpoint.

monitoredSeriesIds.description: The user-selected series subset the author is pinned to when `monitorMode` is `series`. Populated by the detail and update endpoints so the edit modal can preselect chips.

lastSync.description: Outcome of the most recent catalogue sync. Held in process memory, so it is absent until this process has synced the author at least once.

AuthorAlias.description: An alternate name resolving to a canonical author, so duplicates like "RR Haywood" and "R.R. Haywood" collapse into one row without losing the original provider id. Also used for release-name matching.

authorId.description: Canonical author this alias points at.

sourceOlId.description: Foreign id the alias came from (e.g. the merged-away author's OpenLibrary id). Omitted when empty.

ids.description: Author ids to act on. Must be non-empty.

monitorMode.description: Required when `action` is `set_monitor_mode`. `series` is rejected in bulk because it needs each author's own series selection.

monitorLatestCount.description: Required (and must be positive) when `monitorMode` is `latest`.

applyMonitorModeToExisting.description: With `set_monitor_mode`, also re-apply the mode to each author's existing books.

monitorNewItems.description: Optional with `set_monitor_mode`. Omitted leaves each author's existing value alone.

AuthorConflict.description: 409 body from the add/relink flows. Carries the canonical author the request collided with when one was identified, so the client can offer a merge.

AuthorListResponse.description: Paginated author page. Clients must unwrap `items`; this replaced the older bare array shape.

total.description: Total rows matching the filter, ignoring limit/offset.

AuthorRefreshStatus.description: Progress of the refresh-all-authors job, persisted under the `authors.bulkRefresh` setting. When no job has ever run the endpoint returns only `{"status":"idle"}`.

message.description: Failure detail, e.g. `interrupted by restart` for a job orphaned by a server restart.

AuthorSyncSkippedBook.description: One dropped work, named so a mis-set filter can be told from a correctly-set one.

language.description: Code the provider reported; empty for the unknown-language case.

AuthorSyncSummary.description: What one catalogue sync did with the works the provider returned: how many became books, and how many each filter dropped. Exists so a mostly-filtered catalogue is visible in the UI instead of only in debug logs.

total.description: Works the providers returned, before filtering.

skippedNotAccepted.description: Works found but not added because the author is not taking newly-discovered books (unmonitored, or monitorNewItems = none).

allowedLanguages.description: The language set this run applied. Empty means no language filter.

unknownLanguageFail.description: The profile's unknown_language_behavior: when true, works the provider gave no language for were dropped too.

skippedLanguageSample.description: First few titles the language filter dropped, capped so a prolific author's rejected tail cannot bloat the payload.

skippedPartBooks.description: Works dropped as box sets, omnibuses, signed-copy cartons or slash-separated anthologies by the metadata profile's SkipPartBooks setting.

skippedMissingDate.description: Works dropped for carrying no release date, with SkipMissingDate enabled.

skippedMinPopularity.description: Works dropped for a ratings count below the profile's MinPopularity floor. Unreleased works are exempt.

skippedMinPages.description: Works dropped because every edition with a known page count fell below MinPages. Works with no page count at all pass through.

skippedMissingIsbn.description: Works dropped because no edition carried an ISBN-13 or ISBN-10, with SkipMissingISBN enabled.

BackupFile.description: A stored backup, as listed from <dataDir>/backups (local type backupFile in BackupHandler.List).

path.description: Absolute path inside a configured library root.

BatchImportResult.description: Per-item validation outcome. The actual import runs asynchronously after a successful validation.

error.description: Present only when the item was rejected.

downloadId.description: Id of the synthetic download record created for an accepted item.

ids.description: Blocklist entry ids to delete, applied serially in order. An empty or absent array deletes nothing and still answers 204.

guid.description: Release GUID, or the source title when the originating event carried no GUID.

reason.description: Why the release was blocked. When promoted from history this is the source event type.

createdByUserId.description: Which user promoted this row. Null/absent for system-write paths and legacy rows. Audit-only — the blocklist is global and nothing filters on it.

Book.description: A book in the library. Fields tagged `json:"-"` in Go (edition count, dedup key, Hardcover foreign ID, compilation flag, owner user ID, provider ISBNs, credited author foreign IDs and transport-only series refs) are internal and never serialised.

id.description: Primary key. 0 on transient provider records returned by lookup/search.

foreignBookId.description: The metadata provider's stable identifier for this work.

sortTitle.description: Title normalised for sorting (leading articles stripped). Overwritten with the raw title on a manual title edit.

originalTitle.description: The work's original-language title, when the provider reports one.

description.description: Provider blurb. HTML-cleaned by every handler that returns a book.

imageUrl.description: Cover image URL. Rewritten to the local image proxy (`/api/v1/images?url=…`) on the list, get and rebind responses.

releaseDate.description: Publication date. Accepted as `YYYY-MM-DD` on update; serialised as RFC 3339.

genres.description: Provider genre tags. Null when never populated.

monitored.description: Whether Bindery should try to acquire this book. Unmonitored books are skipped by the wanted scan and by the status-flip auto-grab hook.

status.description: Acquisition state. For a `both` media type the aggregate flips to `imported` only when both formats are on disk.

anyEditionOk.description: Accept any edition rather than only the selected one.

selectedEditionId.description: Pinned edition, when the user picked one.

filePath.description: Legacy single on-disk path, predating the dual-format schema. Set by the importer only — never writable through the API, because it is the target of the on-disk delete paths.

mediaType.description: Which format(s) are wanted. `both` requests an ebook and an audiobook for the same work; the search and import pipelines handle each independently.

narrator.description: Audiobook narrator. Populated by Audnex enrichment.

durationSeconds.description: Audiobook runtime in seconds. Populated by Audnex enrichment.

asin.description: Audible/Amazon identifier. Required before audiobook enrichment.

calibre_id.description: Source Calibre library row, when the book was imported from Calibre. Omitted when unset.

metadataProvider.description: Which provider currently owns this book's identity.

lockedFields.description: Metadata fields the user edited by hand. Every refresh / enrichment / merge path must leave these alone. Set implicitly by editing the corresponding field, replaced wholesale by sending `lockedFields`, and cleared entirely by a rebind.

excluded.description: Hidden from the default library views; excluded books are also skipped by author catalogue syncs.

ebookFilePath.description: Computed view over `book_files` (first ebook path). Read-only — write via the importer, not the API.

audiobookFilePath.description: Computed view over `book_files` (first audiobook path). Read-only. Audiobooks are stored as directories.

author.description: Joined author record. Present only when the query joined it.

editions.description: Joined editions. Present only when hydrated.

bookFiles.description: Every on-disk file tracked for this book. Attached on single-book responses (get, update-by-file-delete, rebind); absent from list responses.

BookFile.description: One on-disk file associated with a book. A book may have several when a download bundle contains multiple formats (epub + mobi + pdf). The `book_files` table is the source of truth; the book's `ebookFilePath` / `audiobookFilePath` are deprecated computed views over it.

path.description: Absolute on-disk path. Audiobook entries are directories.

BookListResponse.description: Paginated wrapper returned by the book list endpoint. Replaces the older bare array shape — clients must unwrap `items`.

items.description: This page of books. Always an array, never null.

total.description: Total rows matching the filter, ignoring limit/offset.

limit.description: Effective page size after defaulting and clamping.

BookRef.description: Minimal book + author projection attached to queue, pending and history rows so the UI can link to /book/:id and /author/:id.

authorName.description: Empty when the book's author projection could not be loaded.

BooksBulkRequest.description: Bulk action request for the books endpoint.

ids.description: Book IDs to act on. An empty or missing list is a 400.

action.description: The action to apply to every ID.

ids.description: Download ids to remove. Must be non-empty.

deleteFiles.description: Destroy the downloaded payload as well as removing it from the client.

unmonitorBooks.description: Also unmonitor each linked book so the scheduler's wanted-search loop cannot immediately re-grab it.

BulkItemResult.description: Per-ID result inside a bulk response.

ok.description: True when the action succeeded for this ID. For the async `search` action this only means the book was found and queued.

BulkResponse.description: Envelope returned by the bulk endpoints. Keys are stringified book IDs; every requested ID has an entry.

results.description: Map of stringified ID to per-item outcome.

CalibreImportProgress.description: Live poll shape for the Calibre import job. `running` decides whether a progress bar is drawn, `total`/`processed` fill it, and `stats` (present only once the run finishes successfully) drives the summary panel. State is held in process memory and resets on restart.

running.description: True while the import goroutine is in flight.

startedAt.description: UTC start time of the current or most recent run. The zero time means no run has happened in this process.

total.description: Books discovered in the Calibre library.

message.description: Current phase, e.g. `opening library…`. Omitted when empty.

error.description: Non-empty when the run failed. Omitted when empty.

finishedAt.description: Set when the run completed (successfully or not). Omitted while running.

stats.description: Populated on completion; omitted while running.

CalibreImportRun.description: A persisted Calibre import run — the durable history record behind the rollback endpoints.

sourceId.description: Identifier of the source library this run imported from.

sourceConfigJson.description: JSON-encoded snapshot of the source configuration used for the run.

finishedAt.description: Omitted while the run is still in progress.

CalibreImportStats.description: Summary counters for one Calibre import run. Populated when the run finishes; the UI renders it in the summary panel once the progress bar completes.

CalibreRollbackAction.description: A single planned (preview) or applied (execute) entity action.

externalId.description: The Calibre-side id the entity came from.

displayName.description: Human-readable label for the UI. Omitted when empty.

outcome.description: How the import originally touched the entity — this is what decides whether rollback deletes the row or restores its fields.

reason.description: Why the action was chosen or skipped. Omitted when empty.

CalibreRollbackResult.description: Payload returned by both the rollback preview and the rollback execute. `preview: true` means nothing was applied; `preview: false` with `applied: true` means every planned action ran.

preview.description: True for the preview endpoint — no mutation occurred.

applied.description: True when the planned actions were executed.

dryRun.description: Whether the original import run was itself a dry run.

status.description: Run status: the run's current status for a preview, `rolled_back` after a successful execute.

filesOnDiskWarning.description: Set when the run touched rows that point at on-disk files. Rollback is metadata-only, so those files stay put. Omitted when empty.

CalibreRollbackStats.description: Per-run rollback roll-up returned by both preview and execute.

filesAffected.description: Rows pointing at on-disk files. Rollback is metadata-only — the files themselves are never touched.

CalibreSyncError.description: One per-book failure from a Calibre bulk push.

path.description: File path that failed to push. Omitted when empty.

CalibreSyncProgress.description: Polled shape for the Calibre bulk-push job. `running: false` with a non-null `finishedAt` means the last run is complete; `running: false` with a zero `startedAt` means nothing has run in this process.

message.description: Current phase, e.g. `listing imported books…`. Omitted when empty.

errors.description: Bounded sample of per-book failures — capped at 50 entries so a run that fails on every book does not re-serialize thousands of near-identical records on each poll.

CalibreSyncStats.description: Roll-up for one Calibre bulk-push run, cumulative across every imported book that has a file path.

total.description: Eligible books (status `imported` with a resolvable push path).

alreadyInCalibre.description: Plugin returned 409 Conflict — the book was already there. Counted as success for idempotency.

failed.description: Everything else. Always the true failure count, even when the `errors` sample is truncated.

CalibreTestResponse.description: Result of a Calibre connectivity probe. All values are strings, including `ok` (which is the literal string `"true"`, not a boolean) — the handler encodes a `map[string]string`.

ok.description: Always the literal string `"true"` on a successful probe.

version.description: Version reported by the Bridge plugin or by `calibredb`.

currentPassword.description: Verified against the stored hash; a mismatch is a 401.

token.description: The preview token returned by POST /api/v1/migrate/goodreads/preview. Trimmed before use; empty after trimming is a 400. Consumed on success — a second commit with the same token is a 404.

foreignAuthorId.description: Provider id of the author to add. Required.

authorName.description: Name as the user chose it. Required; also recorded as an alias so the chosen spelling keeps matching releases.

metadataProfileId.description: Omitted/null assigns the seeded default (Standard) profile.

monitorMode.description: Omitted uses the install-wide default. Rejected unless one of the listed values.

monitorLatestCount.description: Omitted uses the install-wide default. Must be positive.

searchOnAdd.description: Queue indexer searches for the books created by the initial catalogue sync.

mediaType.description: Media type for books created by the initial sync. Empty uses the global `default.media_type` setting.

CreateBackupRequest.description: Optional body for createBackup. Read through a 4 KiB limit; a missing, empty or undecodable body is ignored rather than rejected.

label.description: User-supplied tag folded into the filename (e.g. "pre-import"). Sanitised to [A-Za-z0-9_-] — every other character becomes '-', separator runs collapse, leading/trailing separators are trimmed — and capped at 40 characters. If nothing usable remains the backup keeps its plain timestamp name.

CreateBackupResponse.description: Result of a successful VACUUM INTO snapshot.

name.description: Generated filename: bindery_<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>.db, or bindery_<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>_<label>.db when a usable label was supplied.

size.description: Size of the snapshot in bytes. 0 if the post-rename stat failed.

modTime.description: Time the response was built (UTC), not the file's stat time.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the snapshot in milliseconds. VACUUM INTO is O(database size).

CreateImportListExclusionRequest.description:
Create body for an import-list exclusion. Only `foreignId` is required — the handler rejects an empty one with 400 and assigns `id`/`createdAt` itself, ignoring anything the client sends for them.

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

foreignId.description: Provider id of the excluded work. Required on create.

CreateRootFolderRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/rootfolder`.

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

path.description: Absolute path to register. Must already exist, be accessible, and be a directory.

title.description: Series title. Trimmed; must be non-empty and at most 500 characters.

role.description: Only the exact value `admin` promotes the new user; anything else (or omitted) leaves the default `user`.

CreateUserRequest.description: Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

CsrfTokenResponse.description: Response of GET /api/v1/auth/csrf. The same value is also set as the readable `bindery_csrf` cookie.

csrfToken.description: Token to replay as the `X-CSRF-Token` header on mutating requests. Empty when the caller has no session cookie.

CustomCondition.description:
models.CustomCondition — one matching rule inside a custom format. Nothing here is validated by the API: `type` is not checked against the documented set and `pattern` is not compiled, so a malformed rule is stored and only fails (or silently never matches) downstream.

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

type.description: What the condition matches against. The Go field comment documents `releaseTitle`, `releaseGroup`, `size`, `indexerFlag`; the value is stored verbatim and is not validated, so this is a convention rather than an enforced enum.

pattern.description: The pattern/value matched against the field named by `type`. Stored verbatim and never compiled or range-checked at write time.

negate.description: Invert the match — the condition holds when the pattern does NOT match.

required.description: The condition must match for the format to apply at all, rather than merely contributing to it.

CustomFormat.description:
models.CustomFormat — a named set of release-matching conditions (the TRaSH-style scoring/filtering primitive). Conditions are persisted as a JSON blob in a single TEXT column. No owner column: custom formats are shared deployment config, which is why the whole route group is admin-only.

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

id.description: Server-assigned row id (SQLite AUTOINCREMENT). Ignored on input — on create the assigned id is written back, on update the path id wins.

name.description: Format name. Required on create (400 `name required` when empty); NOT re-validated on update, so a PUT omitting it stores an empty string. Not unique — no collision check. LIST is ordered by this field.

A webhook notification connection. Bindery has exactly one delivery implementation — an outbound JSON HTTP request — so `type` is a stored label rather than a dispatch discriminator; per-target behaviour is derived from `url` and `topic` instead (see those fields).

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

Target-specific behaviour is inferred, not configured: a `url` whose path contains a `notify` segment is treated as an apprise-api endpoint and has the reserved `format` key stripped from the payload (the value stays available as `mediaFormat`); a non-empty `topic` switches the target to the URL's server root and adds a `topic` field so ntfy renders the JSON natively; `headers` carries anything else the target needs (ntfy bearer token, Discord routing).

headers.description: Extra request headers as a **JSON-encoded string** holding a flat object of string values, e.g. `{"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}`. id.description: Stable provider identifier used in the login/callback paths. Must match `^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$` to be usable for login.

name.description: Display name rendered on the login page.

client_secret.description: Write-only. Submit an empty string to preserve the currently stored secret for this `id`; omitting it for a provider id that does not yet exist is a 400.

scopes.description: Requested scopes. Empty falls back to `openid`, `profile`, `email`.

allowed_groups.description: When non-empty, a login is admitted only if the user's group claim intersects this list. Fail-closed: a missing or misnamed group claim rejects every login.

link.description: Acquisition, cover-image, thumbnail and subsection links for this entry.

Serialized as XML, never JSON — property names below map to child elements/attributes, and namespace prefixes (`dc:`, `opds:`, `opensearch:`) are emitted literally because Go's auto-prefixing confuses strict clients such as KOReader's parser. The feed kind (navigation vs acquisition) is signalled by the `type` of the `rel="self"` link, not by the Content-Type header, which is always `application/atom+xml;profile=opds-catalog;charset=utf-8`.

opensearch:totalResults.description: Total matching entries across all pages; omitted when zero.

opensearch:itemsPerPage.description: Page size — 50 for the paginated feeds; omitted when zero.

opensearch:startIndex.description: 1-based index of the first entry on this page; omitted when zero.

href.description: Absolute URL built from the request's scheme/host (honouring `X-Forwarded-Proto` / `X-Forwarded-Host`).

type.description: Target media type — `application/atom+xml;profile=opds-catalog;kind=navigation` or `...;kind=acquisition` for feed links, or the file/image media type for acquisition and cover links.

opds:count.description: Number of entries behind a subsection link, so clients can render "Authors (152)" without a probe.

OkResponse.description: The bare acknowledgement body the auth endpoints return on success.

status.description: `ok` = the resolved path was stat-able. `warning` = the path resolved but Bindery cannot see it, so the connection is fine but nothing will import. The third internal value `unknown` is never serialised — the field is dropped instead.

path.description: The resolved, path-remapped local path that was stat'd.

mediaType.description: Scopes the entry to the format being searched, so a dual-format book's ebook and audiobook entries are managed independently.

reason.description: Why the release is still pending.

releaseJson.description: The raw indexer search result as a JSON-encoded string. The `nzbUrl` inside it has its indexer apikey redacted on the way out; the stored copy keeps the signed URL for force-grab.

ProwlarrInstance.description:
Connection config for a Prowlarr server (`models.ProwlarrInstance`). `apiKey` is not write-only — it round-trips in read responses, which is why the entire `/prowlarr` subtree is admin-only.

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

id.description: Server-assigned row id. On update it is overwritten with the path `{id}`.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to `Prowlarr` when empty on create.

url.description: Base URL of the Prowlarr server. Required on create and validated by `httpsec.ValidateOutboundURL` (LAN+loopback).

apiKey.description: Prowlarr API key. SENSITIVE. This value is stored in plaintext and IS echoed back verbatim in every read response (List/Get) and in the 200 body of Create/Update — the server performs no redaction or write-only masking. This is precisely why the whole route subtree is gated behind `auth.RequireAdmin`. Treat any response containing it as a credential. Changing it via PUT also rewrites the stored apiKey of every indexer synced from this instance.

lastSyncAt.description: Timestamp of the last successful sync.

QualityItem.description:
models.QualityItem — one entry in a quality profile's preference list.

Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

quality.description: File-format token. Trimmed and lower-cased server-side; must be non-empty and unique within the profile. Not restricted to a fixed set, but only the tokens in models.QualityRank carry an ordering: unknown(0), txt(1), rtf(2), pdf(3), mobi(4), azw(4), epub(5), azw3(6), mp3(7), m4a(8), m4b(9), flac(10).

allowed.description: Whether releases of this format may be grabbed. At least one item in a profile must set this true.

models.QualityProfile — an ordered file-format preference list plus an upgrade cutoff, assignable to authors. Reverse-engineered from the upstream sources; `additionalProperties: false` is set deliberately so the crate's conformance tests catch a hallucinated or mis-cased key rather than silently accepting it.

id.description: Server-assigned row id (SQLite AUTOINCREMENT). Forced to 0 on create and taken from the path on update, so any client-supplied value is ignored.

name.description: Profile name. Trimmed server-side; must be non-empty and unique across all profiles (the column is UNIQUE and the handler pre-checks, returning 409).

createdAt.description: Row creation time (SQLite CURRENT_TIMESTAMP). Never writable. Note: create and update do not re-read the row, so the 201/200 body echoes whatever the client sent — the Go zero time `0001-01-01T00:00:00Z` when omitted. Only the GET/LIST bodies carry the real value.

error.description: Single-line, user-readable explanation, e.g. `in use by author Frank Herbert`, `in use by 3 authors: A, B, C`, or `in use by 12 authors including A, B, C, D, E`.

authorCount.description: Total number of authors assigned this profile.

authorNames.description: Up to 5 of those author names, ordered by name. May be empty if the name lookup itself failed (the error is swallowed).

partial.description: True when at least one download client failed or timed out during enrichment. Omitted when false.

message.description: The upstream error, or `live-status poll timed out`.

ReadarrProgress.description: Snapshot of the shared ReadarrImporter's state. Only one import runs at a time.

running.description: Whether an import is in flight.

startedAt.description: When the current or last import began. Zero value (0001-01-01T00:00:00Z) when none has ever started.

message.description: Latest human-readable progress message. Omitted when empty.

error.description: Terminal error from the last run. Omitted when the run succeeded or none has finished.

finishedAt.description: When the last import finished. Omitted while running or before the first run.

result.description: Per-entity tallies, present only once an import has completed.

targetBookId.description: The book the file should belong to. Must be positive.

force.description: Override the author-mismatch guard, accepting that the upstream record is credited to a different author.

current_author.description: Name of the author the book is currently filed under.

upstream_author.description: Name of the author the requested upstream record is credited to.

force_required.description: Always true when present — retry with `force:true` to proceed.

foreignId.description: Metadata-provider id of the recommended work.

authorId.description: Set when the author already exists locally. Omitted otherwise.

reason.description: Human-readable justification shown in the UI.

seriesId.description: Omitted when the recommendation is not series-driven.

dismissed.description: Always false in list responses — dismissed rows are filtered out.

batchId.description: Groups the recommendations produced by one engine run.

apiKey.description: The freshly generated 32-byte hex key. Returned once here; afterwards readable only by an admin via GET /api/v1/auth/config.

authorName.description: Candidate name to confirm the match against when resolving by foreign id or by search.

toMove.description: Files whose proposed path differs from their current one and are ready to move.

noop.description: Files already at the templated location.

collision.description: A different file already occupies the proposed path.

missing.description: The tracked file is not on disk.

authorName.description: Display name for the chosen author.

message.description: Human-readable confirmation; instructs the operator to restart the server, which the handler does not do itself.
